title: WPMS/247/2014 of M/s Mittal And Brothers AND OTHERS Vs Nagar Nigam Haridwar

paras.text:
WPMS 247 of 2014
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mrs. Prabha Naithani, Advocate for
the petitioners.
Mr. Sandeep Kothari, Advocate for
the respondent.
Vide order dated 28.12.2013,
contractors were directed to make supply of
the goods within three days and to submit
the stamp paper for execution of the formal
agreement.
The case of the petitioners is that
stamp papers were submitted within three
days for the execution and signature of the
formal agreement, however, respondents
did not execute and sign the formal
agreement and instead cancelled the supply
order dated 28.12.2013 vide impugned
order dated 21.01.2014.
Learned counsel for the petitioners
submits that petitioners were under the
bonafide impression that after the execution
and signature of the formal agreement
supply has to be made, therefore, no fault
can be attributed to the petitioners and
order dated 21.01.2014 on hyper technical
ground cancelling the supply order is bad in
law.
Perusal of the order dated 28.12.2013
would go to demonstrate that suppliers /
petitioners were asked to make supply
within three days alongwith the stamp
papers for the execution of formal
agreement. It nowhere says nor any
condition of the tender says that supply has
to be made only after execution of the

agreement. In my humble opinion,
petitioners should have made supply within
three days as stipulated in the said order.
Since petitioners failed to make supply till
21.01.2014, therefore, respondents were
well within jurisdiction in cancelling the
supply order vide impugned order dated
21.01.2014.
Consequently, the writ petition fails
and is hereby dismissed.
(Alok Singh, J.)
Dated 24.03.2014
Shiv
